stem: A right triangle has an angle that measures \(30^{\circ}\). The perimeter of the triangle is \(12 + 4\sqrt{3}\). What is the length of the hypotenuse?
solution: In a \(30^{\circ}\)-\(60^{\circ}\)-\(90^{\circ}\) triangle the sides are \(s\), \(s\sqrt{3}\), and \(2s\), where \(s\) is the shortest side.
verify:
s=symbols('s',positive=True)
ss=solve(Eq(s+s*sqrt(3)+2*s,12+4*sqrt(3)),s)[0]
assert simplify(ss-4)==0
ans=2*ss
assert simplify(ans-8)==0 and simplify(sin(pi/6)-ss/ans)==0
assert all(Rational(v)==8 for v in spr_answers)
